compatibility: See docs/evaluation-contract.md. Missing optional evaluation output is compatible when neither declared source requirements nor benchmark policy require its contents; no-primary tasks can complete with zero observations.
Only the framework-designated output receives completion-status semantics, when an evaluator is configured or it is explicitly a metric source; unrelated domain JSON status fields remain domain data.
The result cache schema is 7; configured output content, path and evaluator activation affect cache/evidence identity, and activation/path isolate champion-guard history.

metrics.json and ./metrics.json aliases still reach evaluation when pending; symlink/hard-link/escaping output paths are rejected. The framework never overwrites existing output or training metrics with its fallback.
Original test_determinism_hardening_4.py skip-audit test retains every assertion; its fixture now includes completed training so it exercises instrumentation rather than a training admission bypass.

Before freezing the new terminal-boundary file, its proposed symlink-launch expectation was corrected to the existing safe-path rejection contract; that discarded expectation is not a red-to-green claim.

Blocking normal exits delegate to the asynchronous validator/receipt/lifecycle path. A failed best-effort diagnostic marker write cannot suppress failure closure; uncertain termination never fabricates a terminal receipt.
Benchmark failure audit reason compatibility is retained. Sealed validation now also protects existing-output reconciliation.
limits: No actual GPU, evaluator subprocess, paid provider, production license activation, package publication, deployment or live campaign mutation exercised. Tests use real temporary artifact/SQLite/compute receipt paths and double only external execution/hardware boundaries.

Stage, filesystem, observation and compute receipt transitions are not one atomic transaction; attempt fencing, crash recovery, stale-child completion and distributed exactly-once dispatch remain subsequent work.

Evaluation-only retry and immutable generation snapshots are not implemented by this item. A legacy in-place evaluator can itself mutate metrics.json; framework fallback preservation is not an immutability claim about that external script.
Deduplication is per scheduler tick, not across controllers or restarts; legacy no-lake dispatch cannot establish completion from None. Backlog retains known-config and configured checkpoint gates.

Champion progress versus ranking/ties, repeated completion accounting, no-finished revocation, and remaining report/admin/legacy verifier consumers remain open. G1 does not complete V1-01 or V1 as a whole.
Evidence identities protect the read interval, not a globally atomic filesystem/lifecycle decision. Research efficiency or scientific validity gains are not inferred from these tests.
